context: A uni student debates a film professor about award shows
purpose: Teach: ホスト/ギャラリー/ショウ/アカデミー/フレーズ/キレイ/ハート/ファースト

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、昨日のアカデミー賞、見ましたか？正直、ちょっとガッカリしました。
lines.en: Professor, did you watch the Academy Awards yesterday? Honestly, I was a bit disappointed.
lines.style: Casual but respectful student tone, slightly provocative opening to a debate

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もちろん見たわよ。ホストの司会も上手だったし、ショウとしては完成度が高かったと思うけど？
lines.en: Of course I watched it. The host did a great job, and as a show I thought it was very polished.
lines.style: Confident teacher voice, defending her position with measured authority

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも、受賞スピーチって、毎年同じフレーズばかりじゃないですか。家族に感謝、ファーストにこれを捧げます、みたいな。
lines.en: But the acceptance speeches always use the same phrases, don't they? Thanks to family, dedicating it first to so-and-so, that kind of thing.
lines.style: Energetic critique with concrete examples, mildly mocking tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それは表面しか見てないからよ。涙を流す瞬間とか、ハートに響く言葉も確かにあったでしょ。
lines.en: That's only because you're looking at the surface. There were moments of tears and words that genuinely touched the heart.
lines.style: Patient teacher mode, gently correcting with emotional appeal

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うーん、映像はキレイでしたけど、僕にはギャラリーに並んだ高級品の展示会みたいに見えたんですよね。
lines.en: Hmm, the visuals were beautiful, but to me it looked like a gallery exhibition of luxury items.
lines.style: Thoughtful pushback using a vivid metaphor, intellectually playful

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 面白い比喩ね。でも、映画文化を支える舞台でもあるのよ。学生のうちは批判より、まず作品を観て学びなさい。
lines.en: Interesting metaphor. But it's also a stage that supports film culture. As a student, watch the films and learn before criticizing.
lines.style: Acknowledging then redirecting, lecturer-mode with a teaching point

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい…でも、いつか先生と納得いくまで議論したいです。次の授業、楽しみにしてます。
lines.en: Yes... but someday I want to debate this with you until we're both convinced. I'm looking forward to your next class.
lines.style: Conceding gracefully while signaling continued engagement, warm closing
